summary: The patch addresses the issue of not wrapping rationals when using mpmath in lambdify, but there are some minor concerns.

issues.description: The code uses string formatting with positional arguments which can be improved for readability. Using named placeholders or f-strings (if Python version allows) would enhance clarity.
There is no update to the documentation or comments to explain the change, which could help future maintainers understand the rationale behind the modification.
